text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Going forward, heading into sprint and mile GⅠ
races alongside Senior Class runners, this is an
opponent Yamanin Zephyr needs to know.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Speaking of one of them, first of all—

text_block_list.name: Driver
text_block_list.text:
...Well then, Lady Ruby.
The meeting starts at 18:00, so I will come
to pick you up 40 minutes prior.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for your hard work.
I'll see you later, then.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: “—Miss Daiichi Ruby. Good afternoon.”

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...Good day, Yamanin Zephyr.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: (Daiichi Ruby. A member of the "Splendid Clan," a name famous enough that even someone as out of touch as me knows it... And—)

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Is there something you need?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: I've come to ask a favor of you.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: ...Would you run alongside me?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
(The formidable spring storm making her name known in the mile division this year.
A graceful ruby dancing on the wind—)

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
I am terribly sorry, but it is impossible
for me to adjust my schedule for today or tomorrow.

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
"If any time after 5:00 PM the day after tomorrow is fine,
I'd be glad to accept."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —The “Magnificent Clan.”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A collective term for a bloodline that continuously produces figures
who demonstrate preeminent talent in every field, including politics and business,
becoming leading authorities in their domains.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Naturally, that name shines brilliantly even within the history of the Twinkle Series.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: My grandmother, who was twice awarded the URA Award for her great achievements, received immense acclaim for training the next generation after retiring, making our family's name echo across the world.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Her mother bore the name of the 'Apex,' bringing
her family its first Oka Sho victory and winning URA
Awards across two generations to bring them greater glory."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And noble blood carries on.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Daiichi Ruby.
She is the successor to the "Illustrious Lineage,"
the Crimson Jewelâ

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: (Trainer showed me the race records... but it seems Miss Ruby was caught in a terrible tempest during the Classic tier.)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
(Expected to be the heir to the family's royal road...
she missed her chance at the Triple Tiara,
and illness forced her to rest from autumn onwards.)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: (And yet, once she reached the Senior Class—!)

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Hah... *pant*, *pant*, *pant*...!!
*cough*...!!

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text: ...Would that be all?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Ah... y-yes.
Thank you... very much...

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much.
Have a wonderful day.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In contrast to Daiichi Ruby, who gave a calm nod toward us,
I hurried over to Yamanin Zephyr, who was still catching her breath.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
...She's strong. She's fast.
No, but beyond all that—

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Her running... the sheer presence radiating from every single stride
was far too... far too intense...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: So heavy...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...However, Daiichi Ruby is not the only one
Yamanin Zephyr needs to keep in mind."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Adding to this—one more person.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Ayy ayy ayy ayy ayyyy!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Ruuuuuuuuuuun for itttttttt!!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Haah, haah, haah, haah, haah...!!
Urgh... I can't... catch... up...!!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: G-Ghhhh...!! Seriously... what the hell is up with her...!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Ah ha ha ha ha ha!!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
“Laughing... while running...
Daitaku Helios...”

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: (That speed... That speed!! A fierce wind? A gale? No, it's beyond even that...!)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: (And on top of that—)

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Whew, ran my heart out!
Totally RUN & WIN-ning, for real★

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"...Wait, oh?
Oh? Oh? Ooh!?"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Miladyyyyyy!!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Run with me
toooooooo!!!!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: She's even faster than before...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Ms. Helios... That lady.
There seems to be no limit to her speed...!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Miss Ruby, and Miss Helios...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
If one wishes to become the wind along the mile route...
One must surpass these two walls, correct?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Such... a towering wall...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Furrowing her brows harshly, she mutters
in an unusually chilling voice.
choice_data_list: (...I might have put too much pressure on them.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "I thought it would be good to broaden our horizons and learn more about our future rivals, but..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Just as I'd sensed long before her debut, Yamanin Zephyr's passion for racing is pure, powerful, and fiercely burning.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And that is why, at times, that storm of passion
bares its fangs against her very own body and soul.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Ngh, ...pardon?
choice_data_list: We still have time. Let's think up a plan together.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Trainer—

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
...Yes.
I'll be in your care.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: As she somehow nodded in agreement, I nodded back with the utmost sincerity.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: While the tempest Yamanin Zephyr plunged into only grew fiercer—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A sudden report caused a major uproar in the public.
